annotation.title_clean: מפרט מת"י מפמ"כ 395: מיגון לרובוטים תעשייתיים (Industrial robot safeguarding)
annotation.title_en: SII Specification 395: Safeguarding of Industrial Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The Standards Institution of Israel (SII / מכון התקנים הישראלי)
annotation.summary_en: Israeli Standards Institution specification (1993) setting safeguarding requirements for industrial robots: safety fencing, presence-sensing devices, interlocks, limiting devices and marking. It is based on Australian standard AS 2939 and defines restricted spaces, fence opening dimensions and distances, and approved-laboratory testing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Industrial robots must be safeguarded by safety fencing, presence-sensing devices, or other approved equivalent means.
Fixed and interlocked guards must meet dimensional tables for opening sizes and safety distances.
Presence sensors must detect entry into the restricted space and halt automatic operation.
Mechanical and electrical limiting devices must restrict robot motion range.
Based on Australian standard AS 2939; excludes space, underwater, prosthetic and remote-operated machines.
